entries.rationale: The question needs a coherent Conservatory work surface and support rail without advancing later zone or renderer migrations or changing the child's task.

The failed browser proof showed that shorthand token declarations were not inspectable in CSSOM and equal phone columns clipped Replay, so explicit longhands and a wider first action column preserve both governance evidence and the full child-facing label.

The owner explicitly accepted the controlled ART-MIG-04 desktop and phone before-after handoff, so that approval is recorded against the exact rendered comparison hashes and revision without extending to later visual work.

A static observation plate and a visibly distinct construction tray clarify what the child should inspect and what the child can change, while measured responsive composition prevents the desktop treatment from compressing phone tasks.

The owner explicitly accepted the ART-MIG-05 after version after reviewing matched before-and-after renders of active selection, active pattern construction, and real pattern reteach states on the governed desktop and touch-phone viewports.

Early counting is the first deterministic renderer family in ART-MIG-06, so the accepted treatment gives the child one calm work surface and unmistakable counted states while every mathematical and semantic input remains owned by the existing question data.

The owner explicitly accepted the after treatment after reviewing matched before-and-after early-counting renders, and the current integration reproduced every approved after image byte-for-byte across all twelve governed combinations.

The owner explicitly approved the corrected versions after reviewing matched before-and-after renders across all six governed viewports. This approval replaces the platform-rendered check glyph with the exact original CSS-geometric check bytes while preserving the six previously accepted initial-state renders byte-for-byte.

The next bounded ART-MIG-06 family is the released MQ-026 teen-number construction. A pair of deterministic five-by-two trays makes one full ten and the extra ones legible without changing which cells the child may choose, how the response is counted, or what the generator and grader own.

The owner explicitly approved the MQ-026 ten-frame candidate after reviewing exact matched before-and-after response crops for the empty and child-built-twelve states across all six governed viewports. Approval is bound to the shown candidate response bytes and does not authorize changes to other renderers or later pixels. Integration reproduced all twelve approved response crops byte-for-byte; the full-page hashes remain supporting capture context because four partial-state captures changed outside the response area while all twelve integrated full-page captures were stable across two runs.

The owner explicitly approved the exact Beta 8 candidate after reviewing matched protected-main and corrected re-teach comparisons for dense pairing, MQ-026 ten frames, and the MQ-069 litres instrument across phone, tablet, desktop, and the governed short desktop. The approval is bound to the shown comparison bytes and exact index.html candidate hash; it authorizes the responsive layout correction only.

The required Beta 8 Deep UX Census found that the MQ-122 isometric-prism dimension label rendered at 14 CSS pixels, below the unchanged 16-pixel question-text floor, on phone portrait, phone landscape, and tablet portrait. The owner explicitly approved the corrected pixels after reviewing exact matched before-and-after renders of the same deterministic question, sample, tier, representation, theme, state, mode, and affected viewports. Approval is bound to the shown 16-pixel label bytes and does not authorize later visual changes or any census relaxation.
